newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine 8-mth textile exports dip 3.66 pct.
newsitem.headline: Philippine 8-mth textile exports dip 3.66 pct.

text.p: The Philippines' textile exports dipped by 3.66 percent in the first eight months of the year to $1.870 billion from $1.941 billion in the same period last year, documents released by the Garments and Textile Exporting Board on Tuesday showed.
The largest buyer of local textile products was the United States which purchased $1.126 billion worth of clothing products.
The European Union was the second biggest with buy orders worth $280.148 million, followed by Canada with $37.630 million. - Manila newsroom 63 2 8418938 Fax 8176267
